task.title: P6-050: Pin the pull_needs dedupe guard at its server call site, not just the helper
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 9 — Dev loop, tests and test strength). Original id: P6-050. Size: S. Specs: specs/app-ui.md, specs/ui-work-loop.md.

**The `pull_needs` dedupe guard is pinned only at the helper, not at the call site** — `a_duplicated_pull_line_does_not_multiply_the_move` tests `my::needs::dedupe` (`needs.rs:1162`) while the call is in the `#[server]` body (`lib.rs:1367`), and none of `needs.spec.ts`'s five tests ever sends a duplicate line, so **deleting the `dedupe(...)` call would leave the suite green**. The adapter was bound by direct evidence during the task but nothing stands guard. Needs an API-level e2e; the same gap applies to any invariant enforced inside a `#[server]` body.
